summary: Implemented print_json per the spec across rich/highlighter.py (JSONHighlighter), rich/default_styles.py (six json.* styles), rich/json.py (JSON renderable plus __main__ entry), rich/console.py (Console.print_json), rich/__init__.py (package-level print_json), docs (console.rst "Printing JSON" section, reference/json.rst, reference.rst toctree), CHANGELOG.md Unreleased Added entry, and a new tests/test_json.py. Nothing was run and nothing was committed. Tests are unverified: the styled-output test expects ANSI codes I derived by reading style.py (e.g. false = \x1b[3;91m), so check those first if it fails. Fixed during review: the hex branch of the number pattern now precedes the decimal branch so 0x1F matches fully.
